## Purpose
`/admin`: the admin console overview. It shows counts and health, plus setup prompts ("Add a workspace", "Review roles", "Invite people", "Add a second admin").

## Responsibilities
`AdminOverviewPage` reads `adminApi.overview` and `adminApi.health`, and shows next-step cards. Titled "Overview — Admin console".
